# forgejo-mcp: Forgejo & Codeberg Integration Substrate
> FastMCP 3.4.4+ server with SOTA companion webapp. Allows dynamic multi-profile configuration switching (local instances & Codeberg.org) and runner monitoring.

## Architecture
- **Backend (Port 10761)**: Python/FastAPI backend proxy.
- **Frontend (Port 10760)**: React/Vite companion dashboard (Slate/Amber Dark theme).
- **Transport**: Stdio (Claude Desktop) and HTTP.

## Documentation
- [Primary Readme](README.md): Primary benefits and quick install JSON.
- [Install Guide](INSTALL.md): Prerequisites and configuration details.
- [Tool Reference](docs/TOOLS.md): Complete list of registered tools.
- [Development Setup](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): Coding guidelines and just commands.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): Solutions for connectivity issues.

## Configuration
- [Pyproject](pyproject.toml): Python dependencies and build config.
- [Profiles JSON](.env.profiles.json): Dynamic profile tokens (gitignored).
